profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Specialties: Java, C/C++, Distributed Systems, Robotics, Graphics, OpenGL, Java Servlets, Web Services, Data Warehousing, XML

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Manage team of 5 SREs responsible for production operations supporting Google Cloud product Dataflow. Plan and track quarterly KR project work to enhance service efficiency, reliability and observability. Own team roadmap and strategy. Review and approve outage postmortems to analyze system failures and propose follow-up work to improve detection, prevention and mitigation of future incidents. 

Present weekly + monthly service metrics to stakeholders in SRE and product orgs.

Created Cloud Dataflow policies and playbooks for Google Cloud Reliability Risk Controls (RRC), used during key events (i.e. Google Next) to reduce the frequency of high impact outages. Worked with 10 teams across Cloud Data Analytics org to standardize RRC policies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created multi-year roadmap to improve efficiency, reliability and release velocity of the Cloud Dataflow Shuffle Service as the SRE Technical Lead for the service. Reduced operational bottom line by millions of dollars through service changes which dynamically adjusted resource usage to optimize cost and automated pruning unused resources allocations.
 
Developed an automated clustering algorithm to find patterns in alerts. Tuned most common alerts and fixed underlying alert root causes, reduced pages by 55% and production issues by 42% for the Cloud Dataflow SRE team. Awarded a Cloud Tech Impact Award (CTIA).

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: Software Engineering Manager for an 8 person team that built internal tools for the Vendor Operations, Vendor Portal and Editorial Studio Operations teams.  Interface with Product Management Tech team and Project Coordinators with business teams to define requirements, prioritize projects and communicate project status.  Design the architecture and drive the operations decisions for the software developed by the team.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead software engineer for Editorial Studio Operations team.  Built workflow tools and management software to allow Merchant and Studio Operations team coordinate requests for zulily home page photography which highlights vendor products for sale on the site.

Created and deployed Java backend services as well as JavaScript/Angular UI apps deployed via Kubernetes to Google Container Engine.  Leveraged Google Storage for storing images produced by Studio Operations team.  Designed data schemas for tracking image request, image, task and workflow metadata in Mongo.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As Senior Engineer on the Vendor Operations team built mySQL databases and Java web services for automating ingestion of EDI invoices, creation of purchase orders and delivery of purchase orders/invoices via EDI/e-mail. Created JavaScript/Angular UI for managing vendor task workflows to streamline the management of Vendor relations for the Vendor Specialist team.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
For Windows 10, ported location aware scenarios for Cortana from Windows Phone to Windows using the WinRT framework.

For Windows 8.1, integrated Bing Smart Search into Windows Shell. Technical lead for cross-team engagement with Bing to design client/server protocol for sending queries and passing results to the XAML rendering layer. Implemented client portions of the protocol.

For Windows 8, worked on the Live Tiles API.  Wrote client connectivity layers which maintain persistent TCP connection to the Windows Notification Service (WNS) for receiving push notifications. Collaborated with Kernel & WNS teams to design policies for optimizing network usage on Mobile Broadband networks and increasing battery life.

For Windows 7, wrote C++ APIs to search diagnostics shipped in Windows as well as online diagnostics hosted by Microsoft.

For Windows Vista, used C# to build/publish diagnostics for automated problem detection during customer support calls.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · C# · COM · XAML · Networking · Powershell

positions.title: Software Engineer/Technical Lead
positions.description: Led team of developers in design/implementation of technologies related to Direct Navigation business. This included data modeling and RESTful web services for domain management, dynamic content generation for 200,000+ domains and data warehousing of web/click traffic. Worked with Enhance Interactive business to port Advertiser AMS from .NET to MVC design using Jakarta Struts/Velocity. Integrated Auto-CPC functionality into proprietary PPC Engine.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · MySQL · Web Services · RESTful architecture · Perl

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked on Centibots project. Project goal was for 100 robots to autonomously explore/map indoor environments and perform surveillance/people tracking. Developed a multi-threaded multi-robot system in C++. Built models of indoor environments using Bayesian statistical methods/machine learning. Adapted particle filters for localization and map merging.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Vision · Robotics · Machine Learning · C++

publications.title: Extracting places from traces of locations
publications.publisher: ACM SIGMOBILE Mobile Computing and Communications Review · Jul 1, 2005

publications.title: A Practical, Decision-theoretic Approach to Multi-Robot Mapping and Exploration
